description: This file defines a PHP class 'stashrestInterface' that integrates with a version control system (likely Atlassian Stash / Bitbucket Server) via REST API. The class provides methods for connecting to the system, retrieving project, repository, branch, commit information, and configuration templates. It extends a base interface 'codeTrackerInterface' and includes methods for configuration and API interaction.

classes.name: stashrestInterface
classes.description: A PHP class that provides an interface to interact with a version control system's REST API, allowing project, repository, branch, and commit management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the interface, sets configuration, and establishes connection to the system.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes the configuration object with default URLs if they are missing.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the current API client instance.

methods.name: getEnterCodeURL
methods.description: Provides URL for entering code links based on configuration.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the version control system API and tests login.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to the system has been successfully established.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Retrieve information about a specific project by its key.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieve a list of all projects.

methods.name: getProjectsForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Get projects formatted for HTML select inputs.

methods.name: getRepos
methods.description: Retrieve repositories for a given project.

methods.name: getReposForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Retrieve repositories formatted for HTML select inputs.

methods.name: getRepoContent
methods.description: Get the content of a repository at a specific path and branch.

methods.name: getRepoContentForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Get repository content for HTML select, listing directory contents.

methods.name: getBranches
methods.description: Get branches for a repository.

methods.name: getBranchesForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Get branches formatted for HTML select inputs.

methods.name: getCommits
methods.description: Retrieve commits for a repository, optionally for a specific branch.

methods.name: getCommitsForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Get commits formatted for HTML select inputs, including date formatting.

methods.name: objectAttrToKeyName
methods.description: Convert object attribute set to a key-value array for display.

methods.name: objectAttrToIDName
methods.description: Convert object attribute set to an ID-name array for select inputs.

methods.name: objectAttrToIDNameKey
methods.description: Convert object attribute set to an ID-key-name array.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Returns an XML template for configuration settings.

methods.name: checkCfg
methods.description: Checks if configuration is valid and complete, logging errors if not.
